Metadata.component_subtitle: This indicator measures total deaths in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi, disaggregated by citizenship. Death: It is the permanent disappearance of all evidence of life at any time after live birth has taken place (post-natal cessation of vital functions without capability of resuscitation).
